operations.summary: Legacy settings update: reads account row then rewrites email while preserving plan as read.
Self-service plan change: blind update of plan and plan_changed_by.

conflicts.risk_explanation: change_email is read-modify-write: it SELECTs plan then UPDATEs email+plan with the stale read value. A concurrent change_plan blind-UPDATE to plan can be overwritten if email SELECT precedes plan UPDATE and email UPDATE follows it, losing the plan change while leaving plan_changed_by stale.

tests.name: email_vs_plan_lost_update
tests.rationale: Direct lost-update window: email SELECT -> plan UPDATE(pro) -> email UPDATE with stale plan(free) silently reverts plan while email succeeds, also leaving attribution inconsistent.

invariants.description: plan should be pro after serial execution: email preserves whatever it read
email should be updated by legacy txn

tests.name: two_emails_vs_plan
tests.rationale: Widens lost-update window with two legacy readers: if both SELECT free before plan UPDATE and either UPDATEs after, stale plan overwrites pro. Plan invariant stays deterministic because only one plan writer.

invariants.description: only plan writer is pro so serial final plan is always pro
final email is last writer of the two legacy txns

tests.name: email_vs_two_plans
tests.rationale: Stale email write ordered last reverts plan to free which is in neither new value, exposing loss even when two new plan writers race; also shows attribution left pointing to a plan that is no longer present.

invariants.description: serial final plan is last plan writer, never stale free
serial final attribution is one of the two actors
